kits.name: Client / freelance job
kits.summary: Client or freelance job workspace: read-only brief, contract, references and intake, working files, review rounds, frozen deliveries, finance and licences.

kits.name: Comic and storyboard
kits.summary: Comic and storyboard workspace with script, character sheets, per-page stage folders, animatics, review rounds and Git LFS rules.

kits.name: Reusable Python code library
kits.summary: Reusable Python code library: snake_case.py modules with a COMPONENTS.md index and tests, thin runner scripts and componentize specs; not a UI or design-system component library.

kits.name: Game workspace: Unreal + Blender + Houdini
kits.summary: Game workspace with one folder per source asset, an explicit source-to-Unreal manifest, and Git LFS rules for Blender, Houdini and texture files.

kits.name: Godot solo game
kits.summary: Solo Godot game workspace with game-ready assets, scenes, GDScript, resources, source art hidden via .gdignore, and Git LFS rules.

kits.name: Homelab infrastructure
kits.summary: Homelab and infrastructure workspace: host inventory, per-host configs, shared Compose stacks, network rules, runbooks, backup records and changelog.

kits.name: Image generation set
kits.summary: AI still-image generation workspace: read-only references, prompts, ComfyUI workflows, model notes, staged outputs from raw to approved finals, and contact sheets; not LoRA training or a render queue.

kits.name: LoRA and model training
kits.summary: LoRA adapter training workspace for image or text models: staged dataset and captions, datasheets, configs, isolated run folders, fixed evaluation sets and versioned releases; not prompt-based image generation.

kits.name: Music and audio production
kits.summary: Music and audio production workspace with a shared library, per-song folders for generations, recordings, stems, mixes and masters, and releases.

kits.name: Research and writing
kits.summary: Research and writing workspace: read-only sources, reading and synthesis notes, versioned outlines, section drafts, figures, citations and frozen releases.

kits.name: 3D design studio: Blender, Houdini, UE5, Godot & web
kits.summary: Multi-tool 3D design studio workspace: per-asset sources/exports, Blender and Houdini DCC trees, UE5, Godot and Three.js targets, shots and deliveries; not a single-engine game project or an Unreal asset pipeline.

kits.name: YouTube and short-form video channel
kits.summary: YouTube and short-form channel workspace with brand assets, reusable library, idea backlog, episode template, shorts, analytics and Git LFS rules.

kits.name: Video production
kits.summary: AI-assisted video production workspace: locked canon references, generated candidates, approved assets, storyboards, footage, audio, renders and numbered deliverables; not a YouTube channel or a comic.

kits.name: Web app + design assets
kits.summary: Web application workspace with handed-over design sources, design tokens, raw and optimised assets, app code, unit and e2e tests, and Git LFS rules.
